# Ice Mirror — Duchess of Maretonia

Ice Mirror is the fandom name for the elaborately dressed unicorn Duchess of Maretonia, a visiting dignitary in *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic*. Remember her as the mare with the enormous jewel-studded, fan-shaped headdress, usually beside the Duke of Maretonia.

[![Hasbro / DHX Media — the Duchess beside the Duke in Twilight's Kingdom](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/13/461407__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_duchess%2Bof%2Bmaretonia_duke%2Bof%2Bmaretonia_neighbuchadnezzar_princess%2Bcadance_princess%2Bcelestia_princess%2Bluna_alic.png)](https://twibooru.org/461407)

- **Appearance:** Pale gray-white coat, deep magenta mane, light blue eyes, purple and magenta robes, and a white-and-purple headdress decorated with pink and turquoise jewels. Her cutie mark is not verified.
- **Names and continuity:** Duchess of Maretonia is her canonical television title and her licensed Gameloft game name. Ice Mirror is a fandom designation; its original coiner and date are unverified. The [unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) lists both names and records her appearances, including the season-four poster and the recap in Twilight's Kingdom — Part 2 (S4E26).
- **Speaking status:** No individual dialogue or voice actor verified. The Duke, rather than the Duchess, speaks during their departure in the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Twilight%27s_Kingdom_-_Part_1).
- **Licensed game:** The [Gameloft character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony_Friendship_is_Magic_Wiki%3AWorkshop/List_of_My_Little_Pony_%28mobile_game%29_characters/Crystal_Empire?theme=falseCampfire) places her at the Dignitaries' Demesne and describes her fondness for diplomatic discussions and premium seating at the Games. This is game characterization, not additional television dialogue.

## Important moments

- **Royal spectators — Equestria Games (S4E24).** She sits with the Duke near Equestria's princesses, establishing her diplomatic stature. [Episode on Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/equestria-games/umc.cmc.5ssbqlq4qltzwq2hsn5gr0r35?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (timestamp unavailable).
- **Diplomatic visit — Twilight's Kingdom — Part 1 (S4E25).** Flash Sentry announces the pair; their confidential visit, from which Twilight is excluded, helps prompt Twilight to question her purpose as a princess. [Episode on Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/twilights-kingdom---part-1/umc.cmc.rit0fxs1ei5egv4aw82vdyl3?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (timestamp unavailable).
